title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: Monitoring the situation to ensure Backbase services are not affected.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The removal of the 'Send to Coworker' action from the Domain Authentication flow requires users to adopt alternative DNS record update methods.
backbase_rationale: The change may impact integration workflows that relied on the removed action.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android SDK version of 24 (Nougat), breaking compatibility with lower versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its application to target API level 24 or higher, or revert to an older SDK, otherwise integration will fail.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK has been updated to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA accessibility standards.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should verify that its UI complies with the updated accessibility requirements and adjust if necessary.
